160: /// Preservation settings for various attributes
161: ///
162: /// It should be derived from options as follows:
163: ///
164: ///  - if there is a list of attributes to preserve (i.e. `--preserve=ATTR_LIST`) parse that list with [`Attributes::parse_iter`],
165: ///  - if `-p` or `--preserve` is given without arguments, use [`Attributes::DEFAULT`],
166: ///  - if `-a`/`--archive` is passed, use [`Attributes::ALL`],
167: ///  - if `-d` is passed use [`Attributes::LINKS`],
168: ///  - otherwise, use [`Attributes::NONE`].
169: ///
170: /// For full compatibility with GNU, these options should also combine. We
171: /// currently only do a best effort imitation of that behavior, because it is
172: /// difficult to achieve in clap, especially with `--no-preserve`.
173: #[derive(Debug, PartialEq)]
174: pub struct Attributes {
175:     #[cfg(unix)]
176:     pub ownership: Preserve,
177:     pub mode: Preserve,
178:     pub timestamps: Preserve,
179:     pub context: Preserve,
180:     pub links: Preserve,
181:     pub xattr: Preserve,
182: }
183: 
184: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
185: pub enum Preserve {
186:     // explicit means whether the --no-preserve flag is used or not to distinguish out the default value.
187:     // e.g. --no-preserve=mode means mode = No { explicit = true }
188:     No { explicit: bool },
189:     Yes { required: bool },
190: }
191: 
192: impl PartialOrd for Preserve {
193:     fn partial_cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Option<Ordering> {
194:         Some(self.cmp(other))
195:     }
196: }
197: 
198: impl Ord for Preserve {
199:     fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Ordering {
200:         match (self, other) {
201:             (Self::No { .. }, Self::No { .. }) => Ordering::Equal,
202:             (Self::Yes { .. }, Self::No { .. }) => Ordering::Greater,
203:             (Self::No { .. }, Self::Yes { .. }) => Ordering::Less,
204:             (
205:                 Self::Yes { required: req_self },
206:                 Self::Yes {
207:                     required: req_other,
208:                 },
209:             ) => req_self.cmp(req_other),
210:         }
211:     }
212: }

686: #[uucore::main]
687: pub fn uumain(args: impl uucore::Args) -> UResult<()> {
688:     let matches = uu_app().try_get_matches_from(args);
689: 
690:     // The error is parsed here because we do not want version or help being printed to stderr.
691:     if let Err(e) = matches {
692:         let mut app = uu_app();
693: 
694:         match e.kind() {
695:             clap::error::ErrorKind::DisplayHelp => {
696:                 app.print_help()?;
697:             }
698:             clap::error::ErrorKind::DisplayVersion => print!("{}", app.render_version()),
699:             _ => return Err(Box::new(e.with_exit_code(1))),
700:         };
701:     } else if let Ok(mut matches) = matches {
702:         let backup_mode = backup_control::determine_backup_mode(&matches)
703:             .map_err(|e| Error::Backup(format!("{e}")))?;
704: 
705:         let backup_suffix = matches
706:             .get_one::<String>(backup_control::arguments::OPT_SUFFIX)
707:             .cloned()
708:             .unwrap_or_else(|| {
709:                 std::env::var("SIMPLE_BACKUP_SUFFIX").unwrap_or_else(|_| "~".to_owned())
710:             });
711: 
712:         let update_mode = update_control::determine_update_mode(&matches);
713: 
714:         let mut options = Options::from_matches(&matches)?;
715:         options.backup = backup_mode;
716:         options.backup_suffix = backup_suffix;
717:         options.update = update_mode;
718: 
719:         if options.overwrite == OverwriteMode::NoClobber && options.backup != BackupMode::NoBackup {
720:             return Err(UUsageError::new(
721:                 EXIT_ERR,
722:                 "options --backup and --no-clobber are mutually exclusive",
723:             ));
724:         }
725: 
726:         let mut paths: Vec<PathBuf> = matches
727:             .remove_many::<OsString>(options::PATHS)
728:             .map(|v| v.map(PathBuf::from).collect())
729:             .unwrap_or_default();
730: 
731:         if paths.is_empty() {
732:             return Err(Error::from("missing file operand").into());
733:         } else if paths.len() == 1 && options.target_dir.is_none() {
734:             return Err(Error::from(format!(
735:                 "missing destination file operand after {:?}",
736:                 paths[0]
737:             ))
738:             .into());
739:         }
740: 
741:         if options.no_target_dir {
742:             if options.target_dir.is_none() {
743:                 if paths.len() > 2 {
744:                     return Err(Error::from(format!("extra operand {:?}", paths[2])).into());
745:                 }
746:             }
747:         }
748: 
749:         let target = options
750:             .target_dir
751:             .clone()
